title: MAWS vNext Instruction Audit Finding
description: Canonical machine-readable contract for one instruction-integrity audit finding (MAWS-SII-TARGET-SPEC-001 section 6.4). A finding is analysis output from the read-only S3 auditor: it records a detected or declared instruction problem with deterministic provenance (source path, revision, line range, authority class) and an advisory recommendation. A valid finding grants no permission, mutates nothing, blocks nothing by itself, and replaces no authority or approval decision; deterministically proven integrity errors may only gate via existing gate policy owned elsewhere.

audit_id.description: Identifier of the audit run that produced this finding; deterministic function of the audited revision and graph digest.

finding_id.description: Stable identifier for this finding; deterministic function of class, source, line range and evidence so re-running the auditor on an unchanged tree reproduces the id.

finding_class.description: Closed audit taxonomy from spec section 6.2.

determinism.description: deterministic: the problem is reproducibly proven by static reference analysis; semantic_advisory: the diagnosis is heuristic and must never gate.

source_path.description: Repo-relative posix path of the instruction source the finding is anchored to.

source_revision.description: Repository revision the source was audited at; an audit without a revision binding cannot be reconstructed.

line_range.description: 1-based inclusive [start_line, end_line] with start <= end; convention enforced by the emitting auditor and reviewed fixtures.

authority_class.description: Authority class of the audited source (inventory classification: canonical, canonical_contract, shared_core, repo_local).

observed_problem.description: Human-readable statement of what was observed, evidence-anchored.

evidence_refs.description: At least one evidence anchor (graph edge coordinates, file content locator, or run artifact).

inferred_cause.description: Best-effort cause hypothesis or null when the auditor does not infer causes.

confidence.description: Confidence in the diagnosis, not in the authority of the finding.

recommended_action.description: Advisory recommendation for the owner; the auditor itself never applies changes.

requires_owner_review.description: True whenever the finding could have governance effect (blocker risk). Forced by the fail-closed rule below.
